items.title: Dolly Douroux Adams Interview, 1962-04-18
items.q: There's a young Henry Allen they call Red Allen now

ctx.x: And he practically played all those barades and funerals and all such as that.
Do you remember if you ever played in Henry Allen's band? There's a young Henry Allen they call Red Allen now, but the old man that was also named Henry Allen... I think so.
...had a brass band that pushed famous over there. Because he played at all those bands. All of the different bands. Yeah. All those bands in that time. All those brass bands.
